summary: Iteration 4 — full validation of new features: Layer Editor (POST /api/svga/layers), sync SVGA→alpha-webm/mov conversions, async MP4→SVGA (incl. AI bg-removal), async /api/jobs/svga-export (alpha-webm + gif + mp4). Backend: 30/30 regression + 11/11 new = 41/41 passing. Frontend: /editor page fully functional (20 layer rows, all per-layer controls, GIF export completed end-to-end), MP4→SVGA convert dialog (remove-bg-checkbox + preset-select) triggers async job, status polling works, success toast fires and dialog auto-closes. Header 'Editor' nav link + SVGA→Alpha WebM/MOV tool cards all present. Zero console errors.

issues: Success toast shows 'SVGA ready (0.00 MB) — downloading' for tiny synthetic clips because size/1024/1024 rounds to 0.00. Minor UX polish — consider showing bytes/KB when <10KB or using floor of 0.01 MB. Not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: conversions._enc_alpha_webm/mov use fixed subprocess timeout=115s. For longer/larger SVGAs this could truncate. Consider making timeout scale with frame count or exposing via param.

Single background worker (loop.run_in_executor default). Heavy jobs (bg-removal, alpha video) queue sequentially. Documented — but with concurrent user load this becomes a bottleneck; consider a small ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) or per-job process.

Persisting from earlier iterations: BG_JOBS_DIR=/tmp/bgjobs and /tmp/... for job results is ephemeral. After pod restart mongo rows say status=done but the file is gone → 410 to user. Consider startup cleanup that flips orphaned done→expired.

svga_export payload uses int keys via json.loads then int(k) — good. But there's no validation that the layer index actually exists (an edit for a non-existent index is silently ignored in render_frames). Consider returning warning in response.

encode_adaptive attempts=5 hard cap. For >5MB inputs where compression can't reach target, the last iteration is returned regardless (>5MB). Acceptable — but the 'under 5MB' promise isn't strictly guaranteed. Frontend doesn't surface this to the user.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (NEW - 11 tests covering layers, alpha video sync, async mp4-to-svga (both bg on/off), async svga-export for alpha-webm/gif/mp4, bad job id, stats increment)

If sample.svga is regenerated to non-160x160 or non-20 frames, update TestLayers assertions. rca of the issue: No bugs found this iteration. All new endpoints and UI flows behaved as designed.
